env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_index_elements.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_index_elements.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_index_elements.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_index_elements.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/optionindexelements

go 1.27
